=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_merge_lease_env_contract.py:189-193 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The unknown-key violation message in violations() still says "classify it in REQUIRED_KEYS or UNWIRED_KEYS". It does not name OPTIONAL_KEYS, the third category the last run added (rule 5), even though docstring rule 6 now refers to "three lists".
  WHY: Nothing fails at runtime, but the message misleads developers. A new key that only some steps pass (for example, one shaped like MERGE_LEASE_HOLD_LABELS) would be put in REQUIRED_KEYS, which makes every lease step pass it — the over-reach OPTIONAL_KEYS exists to prevent. All four reviewers rated this NIT, and the fix is one line.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:1606, 1866, 2032 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The MERGE_LEASE_TTL_MINUTES fallback is '480', but on this PR head scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2849 has `${MERGE_LEASE_TTL_MINUTES:-240}`. test_repo_workflows_satisfy_contract (tests/test_merge_lease_env_contract.py:287-289) reports default-mismatch violations on the head tree.
  WHY: The reviewers disagree on severity; the highest is used. minimax rated it BLOCKER: the contract test's assertEqual fails on every push until #10046 lands or the values revert. gemini rated it MAJOR: the TTL fallback diverges from the script. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT with confidence 3. Its reasoning: only the head tree is inconsistent; merge-ref CI on head 596dc5c has failed_count=0; the issue's Constraints require #10046's 480/180 defaults once it has merged; the fix is a base sync, and the editor must NOT revert the values to 240/60. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash refutes this as a merge blocker in its notes.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:252-255, 977-980 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: MERGE_LEASE_TTL_MINUTES falls back to '480' (lines 252 and 977) and MERGE_LEASE_IDLE_MINUTES to '180' (lines 255 and 980). The script defaults on this head are 240 (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2849) and 60 (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2888), so the contract test flags them.
  WHY: The severity disagreement is the same as the previous finding and the highest is used: minimax rated it BLOCKER, gemini MAJOR, and anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 NIT with confidence 3. The sonnet reviewer says the 480/180 values are correct for the merged tree, that only a base sync is needed, and that the values must not be reverted. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash refutes this as a merge blocker in its notes.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:1609 vs .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:255, 980 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The three poller blocks keep IDLE='60' while the sweep blocks use IDLE='180'. The changelog nevertheless claims "the same defaults as every other lease step".
  WHY: In a repo where the variable is unset, the sweep idles three times longer than the poller. The contract test only compares each workflow with the script default, never poller with sweep, so it does not catch this. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash says in its notes that these poller lines are untouched base lines and that the merge-ref value there is 180.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "If #10046 has merged, use its new defaults; if not, keep today's and let the defaults test follow whichever is on the branch." (issue #10078 §Constraints)
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml lines 1606, 1866, 2032 and .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml lines 252, 977 (and any other workflow env lines that set MERGE_LEASE_TTL_MINUTES/MERGE_LEASE_IDLE_MINUTES defaults this PR adds)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The branch still holds the old script defaults (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2849 is 240 and :2888 is 60), yet the PR sets TTL='480' in five workflow lines and IDLE='180' in two of them. test_repo_workflows_satisfy_contract (tests/test_merge_lease_env_contract.py:287-289) fails on the PR head with 7 default-mismatch violations. Both reviewers rated this BLOCKER. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly decline this gap: merge-ref CI shows #10046 has merged, so 480/180 is correct.
- requirement: "The defaults in the workflows equal the script defaults in scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh (one test compares them)." (issue #10078 §Goals)
  expected_change_site: Every workflow env block this PR adds or modifies that sets MERGE_LEASE_TTL_MINUTES or MERGE_LEASE_IDLE_MINUTES
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Five env blocks set TTL='480' and two also set IDLE='180', against script defaults of 240 and 60. No hunk brings them back into line on this branch. test_repo_workflows_satisfy_contract (tests/test_merge_lease_env_contract.py:287-289) fails on the PR head. Rated BLOCKER.
- requirement: "Changing any default value (#10046)." listed as a Non-goal (issue #10078 §Non-goals)
  expected_change_site: All five TTL='480' workflow lines and both IDLE='180' sweep lines introduced by this PR
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The PR changes the checked-in workflow fallbacks to 480/180 although #10046 has not landed in scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh on this head. Where the repository variables are unset, these paths now use 480/180 instead of 240/60. Rated MAJOR.
- requirement: "Every poller and sweep path that can grant or renew a merge lease now honours the merge-lease repository variables."
  expected_change_site: changelog.d/10078-merge-lease-env-full-set.md
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The changelog claims "same defaults as every other lease step", but on this branch the poller (60 minutes idle) and the sweep (180 minutes idle) differ. Rated NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- tests/test_merge_lease_env_contract.py:lines 191-192 in violations(), the unknown-key branch | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The last run added OPTIONAL_KEYS (rule 5) and changed rule 6 to say "one of the three lists above", but the failure message still names only REQUIRED_KEYS and UNWIRED_KEYS.
  WHY: Nothing breaks at runtime. A developer adding a key that only some steps pass would be told to put it in REQUIRED_KEYS, which rule 1 would then enforce on every lease step. Fix: add "OPTIONAL_KEYS," to the message (1 line). Also given as the only HARDENING_SUGGESTION (HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1).
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml and .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml, compared with scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:orchestrate_poll.yml:1606/1866/2032 (TTL '480') and review_autofix_sweep.yml:252/977 (TTL '480') and 255/980 (IDLE '180'); scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2849 `${MERGE_LEASE_TTL_MINUTES:-240}` and :2888 `${MERGE_LEASE_IDLE_MINUTES:-60}` | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: On the head tree alone, test_repo_workflows_satisfy_contract finds 7 mismatches (5 TTL, 2 IDLE). The branch is behind main. Merge-ref CI on head 596dc5c has failed_count=0. An earlier CI failure named a test (`Wiring::test_lease_ttl_and_idle_defaults_agree_at_every_site`) that does not exist on this checkout, which shows CI runs the merge ref with #10046's 480/180 defaults.
  WHY: The merged tree does not fail, so this is not a merge blocker; a base sync fixes the head tree. The editor must NOT revert to 240/60, because that would bring back the merge-ref failures seen in CI shards 12 and 31.
- Not re-reported, with reasons: the `_literal_has_comment` residual (accepted earlier and documented at lines 152-153) and the nested-brace regex in optional_script_defaults (cannot be triggered: there is no MERGE_LEASE_HOLD_LABELS expansion in scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh). TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. Every requirement was checked as met, and the #10046 defaults gap is declined per the issue's Constraints.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:1606, 1866, 2032 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: MERGE_LEASE_TTL_MINUTES defaults to '480' instead of the script's default '240' (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2849).
  WHY: When the repository variable is unset, the workflow uses a 480-minute lease, which differs from the repository's established default and may cause unexpected lease expirations or renewals.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:252, 255, 977, 980 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: MERGE_LEASE_TTL_MINUTES defaults to '480' and MERGE_LEASE_IDLE_MINUTES to '180', differing from the script's defaults ('240', '60').
  WHY: These steps use TTL and idle revocation windows that differ from other lease-writing paths, so lease behaviour is inconsistent when the repository variables are unset.

  Evidence of absence: The branch still holds the old script defaults (240/60), yet the PR sets workflow defaults to 480/180. The PR is blocked because the contract test `tests/test_merge_lease_env_contract.py` fails on these mismatches.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
